_readme: Shared excavation state for the discovery loop — read/advance via scripts/rotation.py. Committed so any agent/machine resumes where the last one stopped. History of what is already mined lives in git log + manifest.jsonl.

find_osti.note: run with --rows 50 --pages 2; ~200k records/query universe. Page 169 retry retained after every OSTI request timed out 2026-07-31; finder now exits nonzero on any skipped query so rotation cannot silently advance.

find_archive.note: PAUSED 2026-08-21: archive.org advancedsearch caps deep paging at 10,000 results (HTTP 200 DEEP_PAGING at page 334 with rows=30); last yield 2026-08-06, pointer 980 preserved. Re-aim through the cursor-based /services/search/v1/scrape API before re-enabling.

find_books.note: RE-AIMED 2026-08-24 from global offset 4275 to a stable 128-slot per-query cursor (page 171, query 0). One query/page runs per round, avoiding the 117-request deep-search burst that caused 19 of 20 failures since 2026-08-19. Existing query positions are immutable; append within the 128-slot stride or perform a reviewed cursor migration. OAPEN-hosted PDFs only; per-record OAI license gate keeps CC-BY/BY-SA/CC0.

find_openaire.note: PAUSED 2026-08-18: OpenAIRE enforces page*pageSize <= 10000 and rejects p903 with HTTP 400. Finder now exits nonzero on any incomplete query. Preserve pointer until the query universe is reset/re-aimed. Earlier vein was nearly dry: p1=300, p2=109, p3=52, p4=22.

find_nist.note: RE-AIMED 2026-08-31 after relevance-ranked query pages 7-111 were dry: cursor-enumerate DOI prefix 10.6028 in creation-month segments. Pointer is year*12+month-1 (24143 = 2011-12, the earliest prefix record); ephemeral Crossref cursors live only within a run, so failure retains and replays the re-derivable month. A reviewed four-month sample passed the conservative title gate at 44/44 AEC-relevant titles. Candidate-cap runs request a rotation hold until month dedup drains. Optional backend retains its pointer on API failure. FRONTIER RESET 2026-09-02 from 24338 (2028-03) to 24320 (2026-09): future months are skipped and held; the open current UTC month is scanned and held for periodic re-probes until it closes.

find_zenodo.note: DRY 2026-07-22: p31+p32 both clean 0 (no API error, empty license histogram) — retire from rotation; universe mined p1-32

find_patents.note: weekly buckets 1900..now, walked backwards. Local run history records a successful US attempt for every valid ISO week from 1998-W19 through 2026-W19; many pre-hold buckets ended at the 400-candidate cap, so this skip records the completed excavation pass rather than proof of exhaustion. Re-aimed 2026-08-29 to live, unmined W21 then W20; W22 was still a direct filling page with zero US entries. After W20 the skip jumps to W18. The backwards-only frontier needs periodic live re-probing. Earlier 1925-1940 W01 probes may be harmlessly revisited. Supported --countries values are US (default) and CN.

find_purdue.note: PAUSED 07-10: docs.lib.purdue.edu serves 202-challenge to all our clients (bepress wall; referer trick fails). 400 pur- rows purged from manifest, entries kept in registry. Retry from different network or headless browser.

find_ibpsa.note: RE-AIMED 2026-09-24 from --year 2023 to an index into find_ibpsa.UNIVERSE (76 append-only (conf, year) listings verified on the series index pages, newest first: esim2026, simbuild2026, bs2025, ...). Nothing was ever kept: the 2026-08-05 bs2023/bs2025 attempt lost 881 of 917 fetches to the rate captcha (not blocklisted; 36 hard-403 URLs were). A listing with more new papers than --max, or a captcha answer, holds the slot; past the last slot the backend reports exhausted.

find_escholarship.note: NEW 2026-09-24: '<unit>:<GraphQL more-token|START>' over cedr_cbe (636 items) -> lbnl_et_btus (1,790) -> lbnl_et (6,056) -> lbnl_rw (88,761), ADDED_ASC. At the tail of lbnl_rw the pointer stays on the last page's token to re-probe new deposits. Most pre-2016 LBNL items carry no rights and are skipped (fail-closed).

find_nlr.note: NEW 2026-09-24: '<year>:<OAI resumptionToken|START>' over research-hub.nlr.gov Pure sets publications:yearYYYY, newest year first down to 1975 (53,919 records total; 2024 alone has 2,344). A rejected token restarts its year. Walk does not come back up: re-aim to the current year occasionally.

find_sdz.note: sdz+hdz pages 1-5 mined 07-10 (165 kept), 6-10 mined 07-12 (35+72), 11-15 mined 07-12 (43 sdz; hdz p11 came back EMPTY — series ended earlier than the ~p25 estimate). sdz ends ~p16 — next run p16 likely the last

find_ademe.note: run with --pages 4; categories: 3153-batiment (504 results, mined p1-12), 3149-energies (p1-8), 3509-urbanisme (p1-8); all three still yielding ~80-95/round on 07-12; license=open (non-commercial reuse w/ attribution)

find_kitopen.note: RE-AIMED 2026-09-02 to ddc:720 architecture (1,452 records; live sample 30/90 redistributable fulltexts). ddc:690 remains EXHAUSTED 07-10 after 9,346 records (~700 passed CC filter). ddc:620 was sampled 2026-09-02 and rejected as too broad: batteries, biomedical, electronics, and generic materials dominated.

find_japan.note: nilim 2012-2025 mined (floor 2012); bri reports 139-158 done (new numbers appear at top); --series data (建築研究資料, data.html) walked No.1-217 on 07-17 (+141 appended, ~105 live folders) — re-walk the top numbers occasionally for new releases

find_wiki.note: category mode: depth 1 x cap 250 mined 07-09; depth 2 x cap 400 drained 07-12 (800 capped run + 825 uncapped run < --max 1500 = dry) — advanced to depth 3; expect heavier drift at d3, the gate handles it; langlinks mode saturated; --books zh done. Depth 21 retained after multiple language APIs exhausted 429 retries on 2026-07-31; finder now exits nonzero on incomplete category/book/langlink calls.

find_patents_cn.note: CN patents via Google Patents' /en view (English sitemap titles and Google machine-translated English text, not official Chinese full text; license=open). Same weekly-bucket walk as find_patents, separate pointer; marathon runs it with --countries CN. RE-AIMED 2026-08-17 from 2002-W51 to 2025-W52: 2021-2025 all virgin, probes 2025-W52/2024-W20/2021-W30 each +400 CAPPED (vs ~120 in 2002-2003 era); sitemap top is ~2026-W20 (2026-W24+ 404, W20 empty — re-probe the 2026 weeks when the walk reaches them). Earlier mined: 2018/2019/2020-W03, 2019 whole, 2018-W48.., 2003..2002-W51

find_jrc.note: JRC Publications Repository via OpenAIRE datasource filter -> handle page -> OP-DOI (10.2760 etc, cc-by) + bitstream PDF; run with --rows 40 --max 250. First 15 QUERIES dry at p5; second-wave QUERIES added 07-17 (+61 at p1 rows40) — pointer restarted at p2 for the widened set. Page 23 retained after a handle connection reset on 2026-07-31; finder now exits nonzero on incomplete OpenAIRE or handle requests.

find_govuk.note: PAUSED 2026-08-18: deep Search API page p905 is dominated by fuzzy off-topic results despite AEC query terms. Finder now requires explicit AEC title anchors. Preserve pointer until queries are re-aimed or restarted against a bounded result universe. OGL v3 = open; run with --rows 20 --max 250. Wave-1 (18 queries) mined p1-27; wave-2 +14 UK-policy queries added 2026-07-20 and reset to p1.

find_worldbank.note: PAUSED 2026-08-21 at construction-industry os=8000: broad full-text phrase search retained mostly non-AEC development-economics reports, while project-cycle documents exposed through WDS are not uniformly CC-BY. Re-enable only after adding a calibrated multilingual title/type relevance gate and per-document license mapping; prefer bounded AEC queries such as '"water infrastructure"' (1,946), '"sustainable cities"' (1,298), '"built environment"' (585), or '"thermal insulation"' (195). Resume unfinished '"urban planning"' at os=16400 only after the same repair.

find_jstage.note: AIJ via J-STAGE API, pubyearfrom=2014 (pre-2014 = mojibake, no ToUnicode). Preserved gijutsu pointer 3,201 is past its 3,171-result filtered universe; keikaku exhausted at 3,588 results, kankyo previously ran past its 1,284-result universe, and kouzou was swept before the filtered-series rotation. POLICY-BLOCKED 2026-08-25: J-STAGE Terms for individuals section I articles 2 and 3(5) require a reuse-rights decision before any pointer reset or mechanical bulk download; audit the existing jstage_aij rows before re-enabling.

find_boverket.note: Swedish building authority, ~35 listing pages x ~10 pubs; run with --pages 2 --max 40. Crawl-delay 10s (finder sleeps + build HOST_DELAY). NEW 2026-07-23, Nordic-gap vein.

find_iea.note: NEW VEIN 2026-07-24: iea.org analysis reports, CC BY 4.0 only (licence-gated per page), blob PDFs. KEY_RE \b fix same day (city matched electriCITY; 36 power-sector entries purged+blocklisted): universe now 175 slugs, offsets 0-40 mined under the FIXED regex equivalence. Run with --limit 40; EBC/INIVE annexes remain NO-GO (different channel, ARR)

find_scielo.note: NEW VEIN 2026-07-28: SciELO BRAZIL AEC journals via the ArticleMeta API — the biggest Portuguese built-environment vein on the open web. 11 journals (Ambiente Construído, IBRACON Estruturas e Materiais, Soils and Rocks, LAJSS, urbe, Cadernos Metrópole, RBRH, ...) picked by WoS subject category from a full 16-collection scan (workspace/scan_scielo_journals.py), CC-BY/BY-SA ONLY — NC and ND journals deliberately excluded; ~11.3k articles. PDF URL comes from fulltexts.pdf, else DERIVED from the v702 markup path — the acronym segment must be lowercased ('MR' -> /pdf/mr/) but the filename must NOT be. /j/<acron>/a/<pid>?format=pdf works ONLY on scielo.br, so the legacy /pdf/ path is what the finder builds. ROBOTS PER NATIONAL HOST, THEY DISAGREE: .br Allow /, but .cl and .org.pe are Disallow / (NO-GO, 150 entries reverted this round); .org.co + .edu.uy unreachable from this box; .org.ve does not resolve. Offset 0 mined 07-28; run --per 25 --max 400.

find_openalex.note: RE-AIMED 2026-08-26 after OpenAlex introduced usage pricing: anonymous access has 100 search requests/day, while the old all-query run made 105 requests and exhausted the budget. One query per round stays below the limit at the live ~72-round/day maximum; the flattened cursor advances across the frozen 105-query list, then continues at page 2 and deeper. Any query-list change requires a reviewed cursor migration.

find_openalex_sim.next: sim1 t=373 q=12 w=4 p=2 k=0 sq=6 sw=4 sp=1 sk=0
find_openalex_sim.note: NEW 2026-09-25: openalex_families cursor 'sim1 t=<runs> q=<query> w=<date window> p=<page> k=<results finished on that page>' for the simulation walk plus sq/sw/sp/sk for the SSRN-origin walk. Which walk searches in a round comes from the round id (openalex_families.budget_slot), never from this cursor. A --max or lookup-cap stop keeps the page with its k; a failed or malformed search keeps the whole cursor. Changing openalex_families.SIMULATION queries/windows needs a new version and a reviewed cursor migration.

find_openalex_ai.note: NEW 2026-09-25: openalex_families BUILDING_AI cursor 'ai1 t q w p k' (same semantics as find_openalex_sim's main walk).

find_arxiv.note: PAUSED 2026-08-23: independent pagination exposed severe off-AEC drift by page 8, while 108 serial API queries per round triggered repeated 429s. Pointer 8 is preserved; before re-enabling, capture primary category and abstract metadata, calibrate a structured relevance filter, re-aim to reviewed shallower pages, and reduce request volume. Partial upstream runs request a hold so a page is never burned.

find_vendor.note: Round-robin over ENABLED vendors in registry/vendors.json (cursor % V); progress inside a vendor is the registry/manifest/blocklist dedup, so the pointer only spreads consecutive rounds across hosts. No rotation hold by design. NEW 2026-08-28 (operator: ingest HVAC/AEC manufacturer product literature).

find_ojs.note: Index into find_ojs.SITES (append-only list). One venue per round, harvested completely; a --max-capped run requests a rotation hold so the venue drains next round; an index past the end disables the backend as exhausted. Re-enable with a reset only to pick up new issues (dedup makes a re-walk idempotent). NEW 2026-09-24.

find_boverket_bfs.note: NEW 2026-09-25 (compliance/ESG programme). Dynamic cursor reported by the finder (scripts/finder_protocol.py): START | <index into the published-date-sorted rinfo feed> | watch:<date> (full pass done; re-read at most every 7 days).

find_regdocs.note: NEW 2026-09-25 (compliance/ESG programme). Dynamic cursor reported by the finder (scripts/finder_protocol.py): JSON {s: source key, o: offset into its sorted universe, f: universe fingerprint, w: {source: date fully walked}}; round-robin over enabled registry/regdocs.json sources with a 7-day watch phase.

find_eurlex.note: NEW 2026-09-25 (compliance/ESG programme). Dynamic cursor reported by the finder (scripts/finder_protocol.py): JSON {s: seed index into registry/eurlex.json, k: CELEX of the work in progress, i: item offset} | watch:<date> after the last seed (re-walked at most every 7 days).

find_esef.note: NEW 2026-09-25 (compliance/ESG programme). Dynamic cursor reported by the finder (scripts/finder_protocol.py): JSON {e: issuer index into registry/esef.json, p: JSON:API page URL to resume} | watch:<date>.
